mentions.name: Tiny Support
mentions.description: An open source, self-hostable support desk for small businesses. Built as a Rails app, it lets teams connect their email, invite teammates, and answer customer emails together without losing track of who replied to what. It deploys with Kamal on a cheap VPS and deliberately skips AI upsells and enterprise features.
mentions.problem: Big-name support tools cost around $20 per user per month and push AI agents and features a small business would never use; small teams just need a tiny, simple tool that does one thing well.
mentions.audience: Small businesses and small teams that need a simple shared email support desk
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a tiny open source support desk: https://tinysupport.co
